name: 8157-sharegpt-8b-1gpu
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1 -- an 8B model on one card.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, 32 query heads, 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, hidden 4096, bf16, 8.03B params = 16.1 GB of weights; served at max-model-len 8192.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=256, warmup the first 30% by request count, bounded at 2000 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: ShareGPT V3 conversational prompts, single turn, shipped with the item as `configs/data/sharegpt-v3-llama31-4096.jsonl` (4096 rows, 4.5 MB, guidellm `json_file`, `request_format: plain`, so the row text goes to the engine raw rather than through a chat template). Real, not synthetic: prompt mean 221.8 tokens (p50 101, p90 621, max 1021), output mean 200.2 (p50 134, p90 489, max 1838), so the resident batch is a genuine mixture of request sizes and ages.
purpose: An 8B-parameter conversational assistant that answers real chat prompts of mixed lengths for 256 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# vLLM 0.6.1.post2-era EngineArgs: an unknown key is a TypeError at engine construction.
# Do not add keys from a later vLLM.

model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1
pipeline-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 8192
disable-log-requests: true

# LOAD-BEARING FOR SAFETY, not just fidelity: max-num-seqs, not the client, is what bounds KV
# demand. Raise client streams if concurrency is searched, never this.
max-num-seqs: 256
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
